def choose_move(observation):
    px, py = observation.get('self_position', (0, 0))
    ox, oy = observation.get('opponent_position', (px, py))
    resources = observation.get('resources', [])
    territory_targets = observation.get('territory_targets', [])
    enemy_positions = observation.get('enemy_positions', [])
    resource_claims = observation.get('resource_claims', {})
    territory_claims = observation.get('territory_claims', {})

    # Defensive get: check if resources and territory_targets are lists
    if not isinstance(resources, list):
        resources = []
    if not isinstance(territory_targets, list):
        territory_targets = []

    # Seek nearest resource
    if resources:
        res = min(resources, key=lambda r: abs(r[0]-px)+abs(r[1]-py))
        dx = 0 if res[0] == px else (1 if res[0] > px else -1)
        dy = 0 if res[1] == py else (1 if res[1] > py else -1)
        if dx in [-1, 0, 1] and dy in [-1, 0, 1]:
            return [dx, dy]

    # Seek nearest territory target
    if territory_targets:
        tgt = min(territory_targets, key=lambda t: abs(t[0]-px)+abs(t[1]-py))
        dx = 0 if tgt[0] == px else (1 if tgt[0] > px else -1)
        dy = 0 if tgt[1] == py else (1 if tgt[1] > py else -1)
        if dx in [-1, 0, 1] and dy in [-1, 0, 1]:
            return [dx, dy]

    # Pursue opponent (here based on closest enemy)
    # Gather enemy positions if available
    enemies = observation.get('enemy_positions', [])
    if isinstance(enemies, list) and enemies:
        # Take the closest enemy
        enemy = min(enemies, key=lambda e: abs(e[0]-px)+abs(e[1]-py))
        dx = 0 if enemy[0] == px else (1 if enemy[0] > px else -1)
        dy = 0 if enemy[1] == py else (1 if enemy[1] > py else -1)
        return [dx, dy]

    # If no data, stay still
    return [0, 0]
